definitions.scope: all requests admitted by the simulator and written to request_slo
definitions.active: time-weighted mean number of requests in flight during the equal-width bin
definitions.t_ms: right edge of the equal-width bin in simulated wall-clock milliseconds
definitions.peak: exact maximum in-flight request count from the ordered event sweep before binning
definitions.binning: at most 512 equal-width bins; event timestamps are grouped in SQL before the sweep
